verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer page lists access to a sandbox environment as part of its developer program, so a first-party sandbox exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how it is isolated from production data or how it is provisioned or used. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox isolation from production data, details on how sandbox accounts and test data are provisioned, API/CLI targeting of the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Access to developer documentation and sandbox environment
